title: Kinetic type move reel on light grey
summary: Eleven text beats on flat light grey, one type move each: lens pull, centred re-flow, spring rise, four gradient verbs rising through a clip mask, a typed URL. Exits have direction and beat entrances.
use_when: A type-only launch or capability list with no UI to show yet
Listing four one-word verbs of what the product does
A silent autoplay feed where type alone must carry 15 s
Showing off a range of text animation styles in one film

look.type_style: geometric grotesk ~500 weight, sentence case, tight tracking; hero line 19 % H, single verbs 40 % H with a vertical gradient fill, body lines 7 % H in near-black

sfx.event: single verb rises through the clip mask
URL typed one character at a time

structure.shot: one greeting word centred, then the product name joins it in a navy to cyan horizontal gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: word lens pull f1-f11: blur 0.15 em -> 0, scale 1.10 -> 1.00, opacity 0.3 -> 1; f35-f55 re-flow left 285 px on springs.ui 20 fr, name blur-in from peak-velocity frame, sharp 8 fr later; f53-f68 line lifts 130 px easings.inExpo 15 fr, blur + fade last 3 fr

structure.shot: three-word line in near-black, names the core capability
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: per-word spring rise from 1 em below, stagger 3 fr, springs.snappy, settled 15 fr after each word (f73-f90); exit f104-f110 drift up + fade 6 fr

structure.shot: verb one, single word at 40 % H, blue vertical gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: per-letter mask-rise f114-f126, stagger 2.3 fr, springs.maskRise (10 % overshoot at +4-5 fr, settled +12 fr); exit f146-f153 up through the clip top 150 px, easings.inExpo 8 fr

structure.shot: verb two, single word, green vertical gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: same mask-rise from f158 (sheet: first letter at 5.27); exit up through the clip at 6.50 (±0.25 s), easings.inExpo 8 fr

structure.shot: verb three, single word, red vertical gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: same mask-rise from 6.77 (±0.25 s); hold to 7.77; exit up through the clip, easings.inExpo 8 fr, empty frame at 8.00

structure.shot: verb four, single word, indigo vertical gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: same mask-rise from 8.27 (±0.25 s), settled by 8.50; exit up through the clip at 9.27 (±0.25 s), empty at 9.50

structure.shot: two-line statement, line one near-black, line two in a blue to violet gradient
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: per-word spring rise, stagger 3 fr, springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable), in by 9.77 (±0.25 s); exit fade + blur 10.77-10.95 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: three-word line in near-black, names the use case
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: whole-line lens pull: blur 0.15 em -> 0, scale 1.10 -> 1.00, 10 fr, sharp by 11.27 (±0.25 s); exit slides left + fades by 12.00

structure.shot: three-word line continuing the previous one, passes through the frame
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: enters from the right, easings.outExpo, in by 12.27 (±0.25 s); drifts left at 15 px/s (sheet), leaves left word by word with blur by 13.00

structure.shot: three-word benefit line built word by word, always centred
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: progressive re-flow: each word blur-in at the right end, stagger 3 fr, while the line chases centre on springs.ui 21 fr (velocity x0.86 per fr, no overshoot), f390-f411; exit drop + blur at 14.27 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the product URL in near-black body size, typed from a fixed left edge
structure.camera: static (no camera move; only the type moves)
structure.motion: typewriter 1 char per 2-3 fr (14.40-15.50), no caret visible, no re-flow; hold 0.8 s; exit blur-out 16.27-16.40 (±0.25 s)

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, bg, accent for the name gradient
params.content.greeting: one word before the product name in the hook
params.content.name: product name, painted in the accent gradient
params.content.capability: three-word line naming the core capability
params.content.verbs: exactly 4 one-word verbs, each with its own gradient pair
params.content.gradients: 4 [top, bottom] colour pairs for the verbs (default: brand accent tints)
params.content.useCase: two three-word lines, the second continues the first
params.content.benefit: three-word line built word by word
params.content.url: URL typed at the end, defaults to brand.url
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Single shot, 0 cuts; rows are state changes. Measured per frame at 30 fps by a human: lens pull 10 fr (blur 0.15 em, scale 1.10), re-flow springs.ui ~20 fr peak 71 px/fr, mask-rise springs.maskRise 300/20/1 (10.5 % overshoot, peak 6.7 fr, letter stagger 2-2.3 fr), mask exit up 150 px in 8 fr easings.inExpo, word stagger 3 fr. Exits always shorter than entrances. Gradients stay inside the letters (vertical on single verbs). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): lens-pull, line-reflow, gradient-fill-type, slide-through-line. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. The catalogue hint mesh-gradient was not seen: the background is flat.
